newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX index ends muted bourse session lower.
newsitem.headline: German DAX index ends muted bourse session lower.

text.p: 1139 GMT - German shares were generally lower as bourse trade came to a close on Friday, support for the DAX index stabilises at 4,400 points following the record gains of earlier in the week. Any significant gains capped ahead of U.S. jobs data at 1230 GMT. Support also seen from dollar creeping higher at 1.8460/67.
* DAX-30 index ends at 4,408.79 points, down 30.14 points.
* September DAX future at 4,436 points, up 16.
* Focus on Daimler-Benz, down 5.90 marks at 1.48.90 marks after Merrill Lynch and Morgan Stanley lower 1997 and 1998 EPS estimates.
